name: DS Cluster D08: Economic Calendar (Intraday — ffill_day pattern)
description: Tests: is_released fires on 1 bar on intraday, ffill_day carries it through session. CRITICAL intraday pattern.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D08 INTRADAY: Calendar + ffill_day
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
rets = returns()(close)

# === NFP CALENDAR ===
nfp_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=50)()

# WRONG on intraday: only 1 bar is True per event
raw_nfp = nfp_cal.is_released

# CORRECT: carry True through entire trading day
is_nfp_day = ffill_day(nfp_cal.is_released)

# === EVENT-DAY RETURNS ===
nfp_day_return = where(is_nfp_day, rets)

# === REPORTERS ===
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.NewspaperIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Return", dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="NFP Day (ffill_day)"
    )
)(rets, is_nfp_day)

histogram(
    title="Returns on NFP Days (intraday bars)",
    category="Calendar",
    bins=30
)(nfp_day_return)
